nodes.text: Commander, we've received a distress signal from the Kepler outpost. Their automated systems detected an unknown vessel approaching. We need eyes on the situation. Your mission: travel to Kepler and monitor the outpost for anomalies. Duration: 3 cycles. Do you accept?

The Kepler outpost is a minor monitoring station on the outer rim. They've been operational for 12 years without incident. The unknown vessel is registered as ' Vessel ID: UNKNOWN' — no transponder, no comms response. Could be pirates, could be drifters. You'll need to observe and report.
Standard sidearm only. This is a surveillance mission, not combat. Engage only in self-defense. If the situation escalates, retreat and report. We can't risk a diplomatic incident out there.
Excellent. Mission parameters uploaded to your terminal. Travel time: 2 cycles. You'll have 3 cycles at the outpost to complete surveillance. Remember: observe, record, report. Godspeed, Commander.
Very well. The mission will remain available. When you're ready, come back to the Command Center. The outpost's situation won't improve on its own...

Mission Active: Kepler Surveillance

Objective: Monitor the outpost and unknown vessel.
Return within 3 cycles to complete.

completion.text: Welcome back, Commander. Your surveillance data is... fascinating. The unknown vessel was indeed a pirate scout, but they fled when your patrol arrived. The outpost is safe, and thanks to your observations, we've updated our threat protocols. Well done.

failure.text: Commander, you exceeded the mission duration. The Kepler outpost has gone silent. We've dispatched a recovery team, but... this is a significant setback. Don't worry about the debrief—rest up. We'll talk later.
